findings.claim: Saving into a folder that does not exist yet fails, and the plan relies on doing that. The skill passes an explicit `parent=` to `viking_add_resource` for every save (steps 2, 3 and 6). In OpenViking v0.4.17.1 an explicit parent turns off parent auto-create (service/resource_service.py: `create_parent=True` is set only when neither `to` nor `parent` is given). A missing parent then raises "Parent URI does not exist ... Use --parent-auto-create" (parse/tree_builder.py ~L118-134). Only the content root `viking://user/jasper/resources` is exempt. The plugin's `_tool_add_resource` (2.1.1) copies only reason/to/parent/instruction/ wait/timeout into the payload, so `create_parent` cannot reach the server, and none of the seven tools makes a directory. That breaks the flows the plan exists for: a new root the operator names (step 6 and the Outcome's "a new root ... shows up in .map.md" followed by the save), the "subfolder under it" that step 3 proposes, a first post from a new `blogs/<source>/`, and any `clips/<slug>/`. Spike 9 used a stub OpenViking, so it never hit this. Fix inside this ticket's scope: have the `openviking_tools` wrapper send `create_parent: true` on add_resource (override `_tool_add_resource` or handle it in its own `handle_tool_call`), and test it with the stand-in client. The other option is `to=<full uri>`; whether `to` creates missing parents is a spike question. Either way the plan has to say which path it takes.
